results.title: Spirit
results.overview: A celebration of home and belonging in South London. This is a film that tows the line between documentary and narrative, and celebrates neighborhood and the rhythms of everyday life in South London. Friends for over a decade, their closeness runs through the piece; rooted in lived relationships, it resists spectacle in favor of quiet intimacy.

results.title: In the Heart of the South
results.original_title: In the Heart of the South
results.overview: Yura Ivalu is an ambitious Inuk multimedia artist who spirals out of control when an estranged childhood friend, Sesi Ilupaalik, forces Yura to confront the trauma she’s built her career on and the identity she built as an avenue to escape.

results.title: Maya & Samar
results.overview: In contemporary Athens, two young women from conflicting cultures embark on a brief yet torrid affair that endangers the life of one, while propelling the other to instant online fame.

results.title: Our Father
results.overview: After a near-death experience, Peter rejects his father, Ninong Deo, igniting a deadly duel, as the Godfather of the Alpha-Agila gang will stop at nothing to maintain his legacy, proving a chilling truth: blood is not a bond; it's a cage.

results.title: Diary of a Serial Killer
results.overview: Bullied and hungry for power, Joe turns to the dark web to fuel a criminal plan, but reality proves far messier than his ambitions.

results.title: Beauty and the Atheist
results.overview: A successful atheist podcaster crosses paths with a devout Christian. Both share a love for science, but are unable to see eye to eye on matters of the heart. This intellectual film will interest both believer and non-believer alike.

results.title: Eclogues
results.overview: Landscapes are permeable, impermanent. They are hallucinations of literature, manifestations of human manipulation. Like the pixel, they are degraded, rearranged, forgotten. “Eclogues” is an expression of landscape in the purest principles of digital image-making: duration, practicality, limitation. Shot in 2020 in Strafford, Vermont.

results.title: Ever After
results.overview: A group of girlfriends arrive at a forest lodge to celebrate, but things take a horrific turn as they realize that the forest is home to bloodthirsty lunatics who perceive themselves to be characters from classic fairy tales.

results.title: Lilla Marie
results.overview: After a dream convinces her she is going to die, Marie, a wife and mother with a seemingly perfect life, begins to question if the life everyone admires is the one she truly wanted. Leaving her family behind, she invites a mysterious woman to join her on a journey of desire, longing, and self-discovery.

results.title: Tranquility: Aeterna
results.overview: A covert agent is confronted by two god-like beings that have the potential to destroy everything.

results.title: It's a Medical Miracle
results.overview: A young man declared brain-dead suddenly awakens with the ability to hear everything. Seeking the nurse whose voice saved him, he's drawn into a dark game of masks, memories, and revenge where every sound may be a clue or a trap.

results.title: Beyond the Screen: Reality of Indonesia Film Industry
results.original_title: Beyond the Screen: Reality of Indonesia Film Industry
results.overview: This documentary explores how familiar formulas, particularly in the horror genre, continue to dominate Indonesian cinema, raising questions about originality, diversity, and the future of storytelling in a culturally rich nation.

results.title: sitrep
results.overview: In an abandoned dialysis center, a situation report is established.

results.title: Rory McIlroy: The Masters Wait
results.overview: Through years of heartbreak and resilience, Rory McIlroy's pursuit of the Green Jacket at the Masters becomes a reckoning with legacy and the final step toward completing golf's rarest achievement, the career Grand Slam.

results.title: The Revolution Against Death
results.overview: In minimalist villas that already resemble film sets, we meet a community of aging citizens. With the help of technology, they plan to have themselves frozen after death until they can be resurrected. A disturbing visit to an environment where the question arises: Is it still self-deception if everyone else is on board with the idea?

results.title: Total Coverage
results.overview: A compilation of the various angles shot to cover the creation of wet and messy fetish content.

results.title: Little Thief
results.overview: Lupyn returns from prison during the pandemic and plans another job. A local mob boss and a corrupt police lieutenant try to uncover who is disrupting their territory and profit from the situation.

results.title: Tradita
results.overview: Following her husband's death, a widow decides to remarry his former business partner. When the woman's daughter returns home for a break from her college studies, she begins to suspect her stepfather's fidelity. Upon investigation, she discovers that he is having an affair with another woman, who is found dead shortly thereafter.
